kicker: Julia-1, a decision model on mmBERT-small

scenes.headline: How a small encoder picks one option from a list
scenes.sub: Julia-1: one score per mask token, on a multilingual encoder.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Chervil! Julia is a small encoder that picks one answer from a list you hand it. Here's how, and why the list's wording matters.

scenes.text: Every option sits behind its own mask token in the same sequence as the state, and a small head reads one score off each mask.
scenes.say: The idea: each option sits behind its own mask token, next to the state. A small head reads one score off each mask.

steps.say: The question goes first, then each option behind its own mask, then the state.
A twenty-two layer multilingual encoder reads it all at once, in both directions.
One learned row, for choice, score or yes-no, is added to every position.
Two more attention layers let each mask look at the state and the other options again.
A tiny scorer turns each mask into one number, and a softmax picks the answer.

scenes.title: More than 20 options: the Router
scenes.say: The head takes twenty options at most. Longer lists go through a tournament.

items.text: Split the list into groups of 20
items.say: Split the list, in order, into groups of twenty.

items.text: Score every group in one batch
items.say: Score every group in one batch.

items.text: Keep the winner, or the top two
items.say: Keep a clear winner alone, or the top two. A dropped answer never comes back.

items.text: One final call on the survivors
items.say: Then one final call, whose probabilities cover only the finalists.

left.title: Fine-tuned classifier
items: Labels fixed in a 77-way output layer
left.say: A fine-tuned classifier keeps its labels in its weights, needs labelled examples, and retrains for a new label.

right.title: Decision model
items: Labels arrive as strings each call
Their wording is part of the input
A new intent is a new string
right.say: A decision model gets its labels as strings on every call, so their wording is part of what it reads.

scenes.title: Same 100 Banking77 questions, same Router
scenes.note: 72 intents; only the label wording changed
scenes.say: On the same hundred banking questions, the same router scores sixty-two with the benchmark's label sentences, ninety-one with plain intent names.

scenes.text: For a decision model the label strings are input: freeze their wording and order, and measure with your own.
scenes.say: For a decision model, the label strings are input. Freeze their wording and order, and measure with your own.

recap: A mask before each option, one score each
scenes.say: To recap: one score per mask, groups of twenty for long lists, and label wording moves the answer.
